content.description: Illustration showing application of adhesive to windshield seal area using a tool

items: (a) Perform a leak test after hardening time has elapsed.
(b) Seal any leak with adhesive or auto glass sealer.

content.text: Wait at least twice the hardening time before driving the car.

content.description: Two-part illustration showing removal and adhesive application for outside moulding clips

items: (a) Using a knife, remove the adhesive around the installation area of the clips.
(b) Apply adhesive to the installation area of the clips.

content.text: Loosely install the clip and confirm that the clip arm is not protruding above the surface.

content.description: Illustration showing clip installation into moulding on windshield

content.text: (c) Install the clips into the moulding. When installing the moulding, be sure that the clips and fasteners on the body side do not make contact.

content.description: Illustration showing installation of outside moulding with hands positioning the moulding pieces

items: Fit on the upper moulding and tap by hand to fasten the fasteners.
Install the side moulding and slide down the moulding.
